subject: english
question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correctly spelt words.

options.text: He made the most delicious pumkin pie.
The paralel lives of two contemporaries.
She took a pair of sissors and cut his hair.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence with all** correctly spelled** words is **option 4)** "I need a strong adhesive."
